ending.caption.1: You bring the album and poster to Grandma
ending.caption.2: Grandma looks at young Grandpa's photo
ending.caption.3: She tells a warm story about that day
ending.caption.4: You both laugh at Grandpa's old haircut

ending.line.1.child: Grandma! I found it — and a weird poster too!
ending.line.2.grandma: There he is… Grandpa when he was young
ending.line.3.grandma: He had just bought a new bicycle. I still remember the oil smell
ending.line.4.grandma: But that haircut… I told him not to!
ending.line.4.child: Haha he looks like a fluffy chick!
ending.line.5.child: Then next time we go there!

prologue.p1.caption: This is my room. Every adventure starts here.
prologue.p1.me: I love mysteries more than anything!
prologue.p2.caption: Not far away stands Grandma Mali's old wooden house, full of old things and memories.
prologue.p3.caption: Grandma Mali has short, loose silver hair. She is kind and the best storyteller in the village.
prologue.p3.grandma: Come here, dear. I have so many old stories to tell you.
prologue.p4.caption: One day I blinked, and the room turned into a picture of yesterday.
prologue.p4.me: Huh? Why does the room look different?
prologue.p5.caption: For now I can only 'see' other times, but every clue leads into a never ending story.
